title: SREV-054 ARM64EC NtOpenFile xtajit64 range gate contract

return_address.description: Caller return address captured by File_NtOpenFile

module_end.description: Loaded xtajit64.dll module end computed from PE SizeOfImage

contracts: GetModuleHandleW returns a handle for a module loaded in the calling process
The PE SizeOfImage field owns the in-memory image extent
The ARM64EC NtOpenFile compatibility bypass may trigger only inside the half-open xtajit64.dll image range
A zero or invalid xtajit64.dll base/end disables the bypass
The bypass range must not use a hard-coded image-size constant
